layout_provenance.note: 2bed.json has no wall polylines (cameras + door hinges only). These vertices are copied from build_twobed_v4.py, already in apt02_fp.png pixel space, scaled in 3D so outline area = sourced 63 m².

area_note: No independent scale on the layout. metres_per_px = sqrt(63.0/72707.0 px²) = 0.029436. Area residual is 0% BY CONSTRUCTION because the 3D model was scaled to the sourced 63 m². This is not an independent area measurement.
